item.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO (English Dub) - Episode 13 - This Side of Paradise
item.description: It's been 19 months and the Terrans are in bad shape as the Martians have claimed most of Earth. The latest threat is an enemy whose powers allow him to freeze anything within a certain area.

item.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO (English Dub) - Episode 14 - The Beautiful and Damned
item.description: With the help of his new cybernetic eye, Inaho notices that there's something off about Princess Asseylum's behavior. Meanwhile, Princess Lemrina divulges her insecurities to Slaine and Count Saazbaum launches an offensive.

item.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO (English Dub) - Episode 1 - Princess of VERS
item.description: Princess Asseylum wants to see Earth for the first time and plans a goodwill visit. However, Count Cruhteo doesn't seem to be sharing the same feelings about Earth. Does this mean that there will not be peace between Earth and Mars?

item.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO (English Dub) - Episode 2 - Beyond the Horizon
item.description: Martian forces have commenced their attack on the Earth. The Earth's forces stand united, ready to defend against the attack as cities quickly turn into war zones. Inaho and his classmates must struggle to survive as they find themselves being thrown into danger.

item.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO (English Dub) - Episode 3 - The Children's Echelon
item.description: The Earth Forces are in full retreat after the devastating attack from the Martian Kataphrakts. Inaho and his friends are hunkered down in a local school, preparing a counter attack.

item.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO (English Dub) - Episode 4 - Point of No Return
item.description: The Martians bombard the Earth with meteor attacks. Inaho and friends continue to travel with a Terran military squad when they are attacked by another Martian Kataphrakt.

item.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO OVA (English DUB) - Episode 1 - The Penultimate Truth
item.description: Unresolved situations, overflowing emotions, and a conclusion to many issues.

item.title: MF GHOST Season 3 - Episode 29 - Grandma's Kei Truck
item.description: Kanata joins Ren on her trip to Niigata, to visit her Grandma.

item.title: MF GHOST Season 3 (Portuguese Dub) - Episode 26 - Fireball
item.description: Kanata starts re-asserting himself despite his injury, but can he really make up so much lost ground?
